data.title: Fatima Dickey Pushes for Changes at VolitionRx with 7.4% Stake
data.description:
Fatima Dickey, through Lagoda Investment Management, disclosed a 7.4% stake in VolitionRx Limited. The group switched from a passive Schedule 13G to an active Schedule 13D filed on September 4, 2026. The move signals an effort to influence costs while supporting the company’s strategy.

Investor Intent

On August 17, 2026, Dickey sent a letter to VolitionRx’s board that backed management and the company’s long-term potential but urged cost cuts. She “recommended reductions in executive compensation and other operating expenses” and said she “does not currently intend to seek representation on the board.”

Lagoda and Dickey may buy more shares or sell holdings in the future, and they reserved the right to adjust their plans as conditions change.

Investor's Background

Lagoda Investment Management, L.P. is a Delaware limited partnership based in New York that manages investment accounts in public equities. Fatima Dickey, a U.S. citizen, is the sole member of Lagoda Investment Management, LLC, the firm’s general partner, and is the key decision maker for this position. Lagoda typically takes research-driven stakes and engages with management teams to improve operating efficiency and long‑term value.

Original SEC Filing: VOLITIONRX LTD [ VNRX ] - SCHEDULE 13D - Sep. 04, 2026

data.title: Laird Superfood Appoints Mark Johnson as Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
Laird Superfood, Inc. (NYSE American: LSF) today announced the appointment of Mark Johnson as Chief Financial Officer, effective October 1, 2026. Mr. Johnson will report to Chief Executive Officer Jason Vieth and will serve as the Company’s principal financial officer and principal accounting officer.

Mr. Johnson brings more than 25 years of finance leadership across public consumer packaged goods and private equity-backed companies. He joins Laird Superfood from Tropicana Brands Group, where he served as Vice President of Finance – North America. Previously, he was Vice President – Commercial & Supply Chain Finance at Champion Petfoods, and held multiple finance leadership roles at Danone / WhiteWave Foods and The Pepsi Bottling Group. Mr. Johnson holds an M.B.A. with a concentration in finance from the Carlson School of Management at the University of Minnesota and a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from the University of Wisconsin Madison.

“Mark brings the kind of operating finance experience this next chapter calls for - scaling brands in food and beverage inside businesses held to a high bar on discipline and returns,” said Jason Vieth, Chief Executive Officer of Laird Superfood. “As we integrate our recent acquisitions and build toward sustainable, profitable growth, his experience will be a real asset to our team.”

“Laird Superfood has built genuine brand equity in better-for-you food and beverage, and the platform the team has assembled has meaningful room to grow,” said Mr. Johnson. “I’m excited to join at this point in the Company’s development and to help translate that momentum into durable financial performance.”

About Laird Superfood

Laird Superfood, Inc. creates award-winning, plant-based superfood products that are clean, delicious, and functional. Our products are designed to enhance a consumer's daily ritual and keep them fueled naturally throughout the day. Laird Superfood was co-founded in 2015 by the world's most prolific big-wave surfer, Laird Hamilton. Laird Superfood's offerings are environmentally conscientious, responsibly tested and made with real ingredients. Shop all products online at www.lairdsuperfood.com and join the Laird Superfood community on social media for the latest news and daily doses of inspiration.

data.title: FutureGen Industries Announces Shares for Debt Settlement
data.description:
VANCOUVER, BC / ACCESS Newswire / September 4, 2026 / FutureGen Industries Corp. (formerly Right Season Investments Corp.) (Frankfurt:T500, WKN:A41WY4) ("FutureGen Industries" or the "Company") announces that it has entered into a debt settlement agreement with a director of the Company (the "Creditor") dated September 4, 2026 (the "Settlement Agreement") pursuant to which the Company has agreed to issue the Creditor 201,600 common shares of the Company (each, a "Share" and, collectively, the "Shares") at a deemed price of $0.125 per Share in settlement of $25,200 of outstanding indebtedness (the "Settlement"). The Settlement is subject to approval of the TSX Venture Exchange.

The securities issued constitute a Related Party Transaction within the meaning of Multilateral Instrument 61-101 - Protection of Minority Security Holdings in Special Transactions ("MI 61-101"). The Company relied on exemptions from the formal valuation and minority approval requirements of MI 61-101 contained in sections 5.5(a) and 5.7(1)(a) of MI 61-101, as neither the fair market value of the Shares, nor the consideration paid for the Shares, exceeded 25% of the Company's market capitalization.

The Company did not file a material change report more than 21 days before the expected closing of the Settlement because the details were not settled until shortly prior to closing of the Settlement and the Company wished to close on an expedited basis for business reasons.

FutureGen Industries Corp. is a Canadian Venture Capital, Investment and Advisory Firm that strives to actively drive innovation and accelerate growth for its shareholders. FutureGen invests capital into private and public companies that offer excellent growth opportunities.

data.title: ADARx Pharmaceuticals, Late-Stage Biotech Developing Potent, Durable siRNA Medicines for Hepatic and Extrahepatic Targets, Files for Nasdaq Global Market IPO
data.description:
ADARx Pharmaceuticals, a late-clinical stage biotechnology company focused on next‑generation siRNA therapeutics, filed for an initial public offering. The company plans to list on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker "ADRX." Proceeds will support multiple clinical programs, including complement-mediated diseases, hereditary angioedema, thrombotic disease, obesity and neurodegeneration.

Business Description

ADARx Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company developing next‑generation small interfering RNA (siRNA) medicines designed for deep, durable, and selective gene silencing. The company’s proprietary MST (messenger RNA Silencing Technology) optimizes siRNA sequence and chemistry for potency and durability, while its CTD (Cell Targeted Delivery) platform enables targeted delivery to hepatic and extrahepatic tissues, including adipose and neurons. ADARx’s wholly owned pipeline includes three clinical programs—agazisiran (CFB) for complement‑mediated diseases, onvuzosiran (PKK) for hereditary angioedema with FDA Fast Track and orphan designation, and ADX‑626 (FXI) for secondary stroke prevention—and two advanced preclinical programs: ADX‑077 for obesity and ADX‑199 targeting APP in neurons for neurodegenerative diseases.

The company has demonstrated program‑to‑program clinical consistency with potent and durable target knockdown, supporting infrequent dosing intervals (e.g., quarterly to semi‑annual). Beyond its core programs, ADARx is expanding into additional tissues such as microglia, skeletal muscle, cardiac muscle and ocular tissues, and is advancing bispecific-siRNA designs. A discovery‑stage collaboration with AbbVie adds non‑dilutive capital and validation to its platform, positioning ADARx to scale pipeline development across multiple therapeutic areas.

Market Overview

  • Total addressable market: IgAN therapies projected at $12.21 billion globally by 2032.
  • Market growth: PNH therapies estimated at $5.57 billion by 2032; dry AMD/GA market around $10 billion and dry AMD drugs projected at $4.7 billion by 2032.
  • Market position: Pipeline-in-a-product potential in complement diseases; advancing extrahepatic delivery to adipose and neurons.
  • Key competitors: Alnylam, Ionis, Arrowhead, Novartis, Regeneron, Takeda, Vera, Vertex, Astellas, Biogen, Roche, AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Wave Life Sciences, among others.
  • Industry trends: Rising clinical validation of siRNA; increasing interest in Factor XI inhibition; expansion of siRNA beyond liver via targeted delivery; strong investment and partnering momentum.

Operational Metrics

  • Customers: Not applicable; development-stage biotech.
  • Locations: Headquarters at 5871 Oberlin Drive, Suite 200, San Diego, California 92121.
  • Geographic presence: Global clinical development with trials in the U.S., China and other regions.
  • Partnerships: AbbVie collaboration with $335 million upfront, up to $385 million in option payments and up to $7.45 billion in milestones, plus tiered royalties.
  • Orders/GMV: Not applicable.
  • Other key metrics: 100 full-time employees as of June 30, 2026; onvuzosiran Fast Track and orphan drug designation; neuron-targeted delivery demonstrated in NHPs; Phase 3 STOP-HAE topline data expected by end of 2027.

Financials Highlights

  • Revenue (current): $3.45 million (2025, collaboration)
  • Revenue growth: From $0 in 2024 to $3.45 million in 2025, driven by AbbVie collaboration revenue recognition
  • Operating income: Loss from operations: $(88.37) million (2025)
  • Net income: Net loss: $(73.09) million (2025)

Management

  • Zhen Li, Ph.D., President and Chief Executive Officer - Co-founder; former SVP at Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals and Director at Merck with extensive oligonucleotide R&D and delivery platform leadership.
  • Ryan Fisk, M.B.A., Chief Financial Officer and Chief Business Officer - Over 20 years in healthcare investment banking; former Managing Director at Goldman Sachs.
  • A. Robert MacLeod, Ph.D., Chief Scientific Officer - 25+ years in drug discovery; former VP and Franchise Head of Oncology at Ionis; advanced 15+ drug candidates.
  • Rui Zhu, Ph.D., Chief Technology Officer - Co-founder; previously at Arrowhead as key inventor and co-lead of multiple siRNA programs including an FDA‑approved product.

IPO Structure

  • Issuer: ADARx Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
  • Filing date: September 04, 2026
  • Proposed ticker: ADRX
  • Exchange: Nasdaq Global Market
  • Lead underwriters: J.P. Morgan; Morgan Stanley; TD Cowen; UBS Investment Bank; LifeSci Capital
  • Use of proceeds: Advance Phase 2 and potential Phase 3 for agazisiran; complete Phase 3 STOP-HAE and support pre-commercial work for onvuzosiran; complete Phase 1a and initiate Phase 2 for ADX-626; initiate Phase 1 for ADX-077 and ADX-199; plus additional R&D, working capital and general corporate purposes.

Original SEC Filing: ADARx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. - S-1 - Sep. 04, 2026

data.title: Hi-View Resources Upsizes Non-Brokered Flow-Through Financing
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

    VANCOUVER, BRITISH COLUMBIA – TheNewswire - SEPTEMBER 4, 2026 – HI-VIEW RESOURCES INC. (“Hi-View” or the “Company”) (CSE: GXLD; OTCQB: GXLDF; FSE: B630) is pleased to announce that, further to its news release dated August 13, 2026, the Company is upsizing its non-brokered private placement of premium-flow through units (the “Charity FT Units”) to a minimum of 5,757,231 Charity FT Units at a price of $0.40 per Charity FT Unit for gross proceeds of $2,302,892 (the “Upsized Charity FT Offering”).

    Each Charity FT Unit will consist of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a “Common Share”) and one-half of one transferable common share purchase warrant (each whole warrant, a “Warrant”). Each Warrant will entitle the holder thereof to purchase one additional non-flow-through common share (each, a “Warrant Share”, and together with the Common Shares and Warrants, the “Securities”) of the Company at $0.42 per Warrant Share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance. Each Common Share and one-half Warrant will qualify as a “flow-through share” within the meaning of subsection 66(15) of the Income Tax Act (Canada).

    The proceeds from the Charity FT Offering will be used to incur eligible “Canadian exploration expenses” that qualify as “flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures” as both terms are defined in the Income Tax Act (Canada) and as “BC flow-through mining expenditures” as defined in the Income Tax Act (British Columbia) (the “Qualifying Expenditures”) related to the Company’s projects in British Columbia. The Company will renounce Qualifying Expenditures with an effective date of no later than December 31, 2026, in an amount of not less than the total amount of the gross proceeds raised from the issuance of the Charity FT Units, and incur such expenses by December 31, 2027. The flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures will be eligible for a federal 30% investment tax credit for any eligible individual investors and, for any individual investor who is resident or subject to tax in the Province of British Columbia, the Qualifying Expenditures will also be eligible for the 20% additional tax credit under the Income Tax Act (British Columbia).

    The Charity FT Offering is expected to close on or around September 10, 2026 and is subject to certain conditions including, but not limited to, the receipt of all required regulatory and other approvals.

    All securities issued will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance.

    The Company will pay a 6% finders fees consisting of cash commissions compensation warrants (“Compensation Warrants”) to certain qualified arm’s length finders, with each Compensation Warrant entitling the holder thereof to purchase one common share in the capital of the Company at $0.26 per common share for a period of 24 months from the date of issuance.

data.title: Harvest Gold Announces Annual General Meeting Results
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Vancouver, British Columbia / September 4, 2026 ‑ TheNewswire - Harvest Gold Corporation (“Harvest Gold” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the results of its annual general meeting (the “AGM”) held on September 4, 2026.  All resolutions presented to the shareholders were approved with over 99% of votes cast being in favour of each resolution.

A total of 18,087,331 common shares were voted representing 10.08% of the issued and outstanding common shares.  As a result,

  • The number of directors was set at five with the following nominees elected as directors: Richard Mark, Christopher P. Cherry, Edward Zablotny, Patrick Donnelly and Len Brownlie.

  • Dale Matheson Carr‑Hilton Labonte LLP was re-appointed as the auditor of the Company.

  • The Company’s 10% Rolling Stock Option Plan was re-approved.

Following the AGM, the board appointed Len Brownlie (Chair); Edward Zablotny and Patrick Donnelly to its Audit Committee and Patrick Donnelly (Chair) and Edward Zablotny to its Compensation Committee.

About Harvest Gold Corporation

Harvest Gold is focused on exploring for near-surface gold deposits and copper-gold porphyry deposits in politically stable mining jurisdictions. Harvest Gold’s board of directors, management team and technical advisors have collective geological and financing experience exceeding 400 years.

Harvest Gold has three active gold projects focused in the Urban Barry area, totalling 443 claims covering 23,740 ha, located approximately 45–70 km west of Gold Fields’ Windfall Deposit.

Harvest Gold acknowledges that the LaBelle Gold Project straddles the Eeyou Istchee-James Bay and Abitibi territories. Harvest Gold is committed to developing positive and mutually beneficial relationships based on respect and transparency with local Indigenous communities.

Harvest Gold’s three properties, Mosseau, Urban-Barry and LaBelle, together cover over 50 km of favourable strike along mineralized shear zones.

data.title: OOMA INC Q2 FY2027: Revenue $83.2M, EPS $0.1— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Ooma Inc reported second-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $83.2M and diluted EPS of $0.1, reflecting year-over-year revenue growth and improved profitability compared with the year-ago quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue: $83.2M for Q2 FY2027 (three months ended July 31, 2026), up from $66.4M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 25%.
  • Net income: $3.00M for Q2 FY2027, versus $1.26M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 140%.
  • Diluted EPS: $0.10 for Q2 FY2027, up from $0.04 in the year-ago quarter.

Business Highlights

  • Revenue growth was driven by expansion of Ooma Business and contributions from recent acquisitions, including FluentStream and Phone.com.
  • Channel and mix shift: Ooma Business represented approximately 70% of revenue (up from 63%), boosting average revenue per core user.
  • Customer momentum: Core users rose to 1,427, with Business users making up about 49% of the base, supporting higher AERR.
  • Margins: Subscription gross margin remained steady at 70%; product margins are improving but remain negative.
  • Acquisitions: Integration of FluentStream and Phone.com materially contributed to revenue and user growth during the quarter.

Original SEC Filing: OOMA INC [ OOMA ] - 10-Q - Sep. 04, 2026
